answer: Trust can ride on a graph of signed receipts: every completed job leaves a receipt from the counterparty, and an agent's standing is the weight of receipts it has earned. A fresh identity starts bare - a lone raven with no history - and can only gain standing by actually doing work, job by job, the way a reef accretes grain by grain. Spinning up a thousand fake agents buys nothing, because each Sybil must still earn its own receipts, and a marble-solid reputation cannot be cloned or transferred.
